randomized_air_hockey.description: Air-hockey interception with randomized initial puck position and speed, the paper's headline generalization setting.

success_rate.description: Task completion rate for puck interception, the primary scientific quantity.

hit_rate.description: Rate at which the controller contacts the puck, catching policies that only optimize terminal success.

controller_units.description: Controller capacity, preserving the compact-controller constraint of the paper's claim.

train_success_gain.description: Improvement from early training episodes to the visible training tail, rewarding sample-efficient learning progress.

success_rate_iqr.description: Interquartile range of success across seeds, reported for diagnostics; zero-weighted because the baseline run has one seed.

seed_worst_success.description: Worst per-seed success rate, making brittle seed-specific tuning visible.

velocity_range_wide.description: Velocity-range robustness test with the widest main puck-speed range [0.7, 1.5] m/s and the same fixed 1020-unit controller budget.

success_rate.description: Task completion rate under the widest evaluated puck-speed range.

hit_rate.description: Puck-contact rate under the wide speed range, catching policies that miss the underlying control target.

controller_units.description: Controller capacity, preserving the compact-controller constraint under the harder velocity range.

train_success_gain.description: Improvement from early training episodes to the visible training tail under the wide velocity range.

success_rate_iqr.description: Interquartile range of success across seeds under the wide velocity range, reported for diagnostics; zero-weighted because the baseline run has one seed.

seed_worst_success.description: Worst per-seed success rate under the wide velocity range, exposing fragile methods tuned to favorable seeds.
